about.title: About Me
about.bio: I'm a 3rd-year student at Epitech Paris, based in Hauts-de-Seine. Passionate about software engineering across the full stack — from writing UNIX shells in C to building real-time web applications with Nuxt and Vue, I enjoy tackling complex problems and crafting clean, efficient solutions. I've gained professional experience through two internships at Naitways, where I developed enterprise-grade Python tools for cybersecurity and infrastructure automation.

items: 5-year program (BAC+5, RNCP Level 7) — project-based pedagogy fostering autonomy and teamwork
25+ projects developed across C, C++, Haskell, Python, JavaScript, and more
Polled internal database via REST API in order to generate and send an hardening report to clients
Worked on the NBOX - a satellite deployed on client servers for self-configuration and VM management
Developed automation tools in Python for infrastructure management
Developed 13+ enterprise Python tools for cybersecurity and infrastructure automation
Built CVE vulnerability search systems integrating NVD and Vulners APIs
Created FortiGate firewall policy management and synchronization tools
Implemented SSH log aggregation from FortiAnalyzer to InfluxDB
Built a Flask-based release notes generator from GitLab commits
Developed network device integrations (Juniper, LibreNMS, Wazuh)
Created an AI-powered code documentation tool using Ollama (local LLM)

projects.title: Projects
projects.Those Who Listen: Cooperative survival horror game where voice cloning becomes the enemy. Real-time voice cloning (<300ms latency, 100% local processing) lets creatures mimic your teammates. Built with OpenVoice and PyTorch.
projects.LoCode: Lightweight web code editor with Monaco Editor, SSH remote development, integrated terminal, and Electron desktop app.
projects.Glados: Complete programming language interpreter in Haskell with lexer, parser, type checker, and bytecode VM.
projects.R-Type: Multiplayer space shooter game engine with ECS architecture, networking, and SFML 3.0 graphics.
projects.Zappy: Multiplayer networked game with C server, C++/Raylib GUI, and autonomous Python AI agents.
projects.42sh: Advanced UNIX shell in C with alias system, arrow key support, built-in commands, and history.
projects.Arcade: Dynamic game framework with plugin architecture and runtime library loading in C++.
projects.Raytracer: 3D ray tracing engine in C++ with configurable scenes and realistic light rendering.
projects.Cryptography: AES, RSA, and PGP encryption implementation in Python for secure message handling.
projects.Neural Network: Multilayer perceptron built from scratch in pure Python with forward/backpropagation.
projects.JEB Incubator: Full-stack web application with Nuxt/Vue frontend, Deno backend, MongoDB database, and Docker deployment.
projects.Gomoku: AI player for the 5-in-a-row board game with strategic evaluation in C++.
projects.RPG: 2D RPG game engine in C with CSFML - sprites, game mechanics, and world building.
projects.My Marvin: Jenkins CI/CD automation project using Groovy Job DSL and Docker for pipeline management.
projects.Vueling AI: Real-time voice translation system for aircraft with offline capabilities and multi-language support.
projects.IREP ChatBot: AI-powered hackathon project built with Flask, Ollama LLM integration, and SQLite database.
projects.Flame Your Mind: Exit 8-inspired game where you play a scientist trapped in a burning lunar base. Find the differences between scenes to escape through the floors. Built with Godot 4 and Unreal Engine 5.
projects.Event Horizon 5min: 3D spaceship fighter set near a black hole's event horizon. Siphon energy from the singularity while time accelerates — you have 5 minutes to charge your warp drive. Features juicy animations and a tomato Easter egg. Built with Godot 4.
projects.Lost In Space: Solo arcade survival game where you pilot a small spaceship drifting through space. Dodge randomly spawning asteroids at increasing speed and survive as long as possible. Score based on survival time. Built with Godot 4.
projects.Robbers & Cat: Open-world heist game where you steal paintings for a cat mafia. Drive around the city, burglarize locations in Phasmophobia-style gameplay, and escape before the police catches you. Built with Godot 4.
